command:
set -u
printf '%s\n' '--- configured quota ---'
xfs_quota -x -c 'quota -h -u datauser' /srv/data
rm -f /srv/data/quota-test.bin
printf '%s\n' '--- attempt 110 MiB as datauser ---'
runuser -u datauser -- dd if=/dev/zero of=/srv/data/quota-test.bin bs=1M count=110 conv=fsync status=none
rc=$?
size=$(stat -c %s /srv/data/quota-test.bin 2>/dev/null || printf 0)
printf 'dd_exit=%s resulting_bytes=%s\n' "$rc" "$size"
xfs_quota -x -c 'quota -h -u datauser' /srv/data
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: over-limit write unexpectedly succeeded'; rm -f /srv/data/quota-test.bin; exit 1; fi
if [ "$size" -gt 104857600 ]; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: file exceeded 100 MiB hard limit'; rm -f /srv/data/quota-test.bin; exit 1; fi
rm -f /srv/data/quota-test.bin
sync
printf '%s\n' '--- after cleanup ---'
xfs_quota -x -c 'quota -h -u datauser' /srv/data
exit 0
